sections.content: You know *porque* and *por eso* from A2 Unit 5 and *debido a* from B1 Unit 11. This lesson uses them to justify a position about rights and responsibilities: *porque* gives the cause, *por eso* gives the consequence and *debido a* + a noun phrase gives a formal cause.

items.english: We have rights because we are citizens.

items.spanish: La regla es necesaria; por eso debemos cumplirla.
items.english: The rule is necessary; therefore we must follow it.

items.spanish: Debido a la situación, cambiaron la norma.
items.english: Because of the situation, they changed the rule.

sections.content: *Debido a* is followed by a noun phrase (*debido a la situación*), not by a full clause. If you need a verb after the cause, use *porque*.
